title: USGS Landsat 8 Level 2, Collection 2, Tier 1
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: The distributor's own hosted image-collection entry identifies Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS as the source of calibrated reflectance and land surface temperature. SR_B1 through SR_B7 are reflectance outputs. ST_B10 is the land surface temperature band. This catalogue describes a subset of global Level-2, not the first public release.

file.method: Selected, claim-specific paraphrases and short excerpts from the cited passages.
